BC_description: The partial application feature of the `applyEach` function has been removed. Previously, `applyEach` could be invoked with a subset of arguments (e.g., function list and first argument), returning a new function to accept the remaining arguments. This is no longer supported. All arguments must now be provided in a single call to `applyEach`, and any code relying on the partial application behavior must be refactored accordingly.
Adaptation_method:
Before: const partiallyApplied = applyEach(fnList, arg1); partiallyApplied(arg2);
After: applyEach(fnList, arg1, arg2); // All arguments must be passed at once
